title: Node-RED Flow Exception Monitoring
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nodered:event level=error
| stats count as errors, latest(message) as last_message by node_id
| where errors>0
| sort - errors
description: Surfaces exceptions thrown by your Node-RED flows so a crashed node stops silently breaking the automations built on top of it.
value: Node-RED underpins many advanced smart homes; catching node exceptions prevents a single failing function from cascading through your flows.
implementation: Forward Node-RED debug/error output to HEC; schedule hourly and alert on new exception sources.
visualization: Table of Node-RED nodes by error count with last message.
grandmaExplanation: It catches errors in the wiring behind your smart home, so one broken piece does not quietly stop everything.
